Katrina, saw Vetty land Nucleus Research's Hot Companies to Watch list with 22 percent revenue growth.

Growth like that usually creates more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Vetty off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
